classification.resume: This is a digital video recording of a National Council debate on 8 December 2016 concerning the adjustment of health insurance deductibles to cost developments and greater entrepreneurial freedom in healthcare. It features speeches by several National Council members on these two motions. The record is an official parliamentary session capture.
